record.dic_text:
0672 'Ephrath {ef-ra:t'} 或 'Ephrathah {ef-ra:'-ta:}

源自 06509;

欽定本 - Ephrath 5, Ephratah 5; 10

以法他 = "灰燼堆: 多產的地方"
專有名詞 地名
1) 靠近伯特利的地方, 是拉結身亡和埋葬的地方
2) 伯利恆的別名

陰性專有名詞 人名
3) 迦勒的妻子
record.edic_text:
0672 'Ephraath {ef-rawth'} or 'Ephrathah {ef-raw'-thaw}

from 06509;;

AV - Ephrath 5, Ephratah 5; 10

Ephrath or Ephratah = "ash-heap: place of fruitfulness"
n pr loc
1) a place near Bethel where Rachel died and was buried
2) another name for Bethlehem
n pr f
3) wife of Caleb
